independence_statement: Saved before opening local spot, source, media or prior candidate records for these 25 names. Candidate selection used external discovery only.
method_limits: Coordinates are approximate discovery points and do not prove a launch.
Protected-area permission is unresolved unless explicitly sourced.
Full draft/cloud duplication access remained unavailable.

spots.name: Durankulak – Kartaliy South Beach
spots.identity: The exposed beach south of Durankulak, outside the lake itself.
spots.conditions: Seasonal NE–SE wind, waves and an unguarded long beach suit self-sufficient intermediate or expert riders.
spots.access_rules: Confirm the exact launch against the protected lake and dune zones; no lifeguard or verified rescue.
spots.trip_value: Wild coast and credible conditions are attractive, but legal launch and current sport-use evidence remain incomplete.

spots.name: Krapets
spots.identity: The long open beach south of Krapets village.
spots.conditions: May–September winds, waves and broad shallow water are documented for intermediate and advanced kiters.
spots.access_rules: Map swimmer and dune corridors and confirm current rescue/operator coverage.
spots.trip_value: A wild, spacious coast with international sport documentation supports worth_trip after operational correction.

spots.name: Albena
spots.identity: The organised Albena resort beach north of Varna, not the whole Balchik coast.
spots.conditions: Official national material names Albena as a popular surf destination and the resort advertises windsurf services.
spots.access_rules: Pin the current watersports launch and swimmer separation; the evidence lacks a detailed wind profile.
spots.trip_value: Services and destination infrastructure support consideration, but specialist travel value and recurring conditions are not sufficiently demonstrated.

spots.name: Asparuhovo, Varna
spots.identity: The long shallow beach south of Varna's canal entrance.
spots.conditions: Varna Bay has regular breeze and active clubs; the beach is long, wide and shallow.
spots.access_rules: Keep clear of the canal, fishing port, navigation and swimmer sectors; identify the club launch.
spots.trip_value: An accessible urban training venue is useful, but the sources do not establish a dedicated-trip proposition.

spots.name: Kamchia coast
spots.identity: The beach and river-mouth coast adjoining the strict Kamchia reserve.
spots.conditions: No reliable source establishes recurring wind-sport use at a legal launch.
spots.access_rules: Strict-reserve, marine and dune protection require explicit authority permission and a launch outside prohibited habitat.
spots.trip_value: Natural value alone cannot substitute for evidence of legal watersports use.

spots.name: Obzor
spots.identity: The main Obzor beach, not an identified specialist launch.
spots.conditions: A specialist directory claims windsurf use, while official material only supplies broad regional context.
spots.access_rules: Confirm a current launch, operator, rescue and recurring wind window.
spots.trip_value: The available evidence does not establish either robust specialist use or distinctive trip value.

spots.name: Sunny Beach / Nessebar
spots.identity: The school-operated sectors at Sunny Beach North and Nessebar South, not the entire resort strip.
spots.conditions: A current school proves lessons and use on a very long serviced resort beach.
spots.access_rules: Split the two launch sectors and retain swimmers, seasonal crowding and harbour boundaries.
spots.trip_value: Strong resort utility does not by itself show distinctive wind, water or specialist travel value.

spots.name: Pomorie
spots.identity: The sea-side sport beach near Pomorie, not protected Lake Pomorie.
spots.conditions: National tourism identifies Pomorie as a surf destination, but exact active launch and conditions are unresolved.
spots.access_rules: Separate sea launch from Ramsar wetland, and confirm current permission, operator and rescue.
spots.trip_value: Potential destination value exists, but wetland boundaries and operational evidence block confirmation.

spots.name: Sarafovo, Burgas
spots.identity: The Sarafovo beach launch on Burgas Bay.
spots.conditions: E–SW winds produce flat water, chop or small waves; a documented IKO school serves multiple levels.
spots.access_rules: Map the launch around swimmers, groynes and airport/urban constraints and verify current rescue.
spots.trip_value: Established instruction, usable condition range and Burgas access support worth_trip after launch correction.

spots.name: Lake Atanasovsko
spots.identity: The protected saline lake north of Burgas, not adjacent Sarafovo sea beach.
spots.conditions: No reliable source establishes legal wind-sport use.
spots.access_rules: Ramsar and Natura 2000 habitat protection is central; do not infer access from adjacent roads or beaches.
spots.trip_value: The candidate lacks discipline-specific and legal-use evidence.

spots.name: Gradina, Chernomorets
spots.identity: The Gradina/Zlatna Ribka windsurf beach between Chernomorets and Sozopol.
spots.conditions: The tourism ministry identifies some of Bulgaria's best windsurf conditions here; a long-running school serves beginner through advanced levels.
spots.access_rules: Pin the school/launch and swimmer/campsite separation and retain seasonal rescue information.
spots.trip_value: National recognition, mature instruction and a broad sandy bay support worth_trip.

spots.name: Harmanite, Sozopol
spots.identity: The guarded urban Harmanite beach south of Sozopol old town.
spots.conditions: Windsurf is available on windy days, with shallow water and nearby centres.
spots.access_rules: Seasonal swimmer density and guarded bathing zones constrain launch use.
spots.trip_value: This is a convenient activity beach, but sources do not show a recurring specialist condition or dedicated-trip value.

spots.name: Ahtopol
spots.identity: The rocky/open coast around Ahtopol; an exact legal launch is not verified.
spots.conditions: One low-authority directory claims strong summer/autumn wind, waves and advanced use.
spots.access_rules: Confirm the launch, rock hazards, protected-coast rules, rescue and a current operator/community source.
spots.trip_value: A single specialist claim plus general tourism context is insufficient.

spots.name: Silistar
spots.identity: The small protected bay south of Sinemorets.
spots.conditions: National tourism names Silistar among surf destinations, but no precise conditions or active launch are established.
spots.access_rules: Explicit protected-area permission, beach zoning and access must be confirmed before recommending rigging or launch.
spots.trip_value: The setting and national mention are promising, but conservation rules and weak operational detail require more research.

spots.name: Mamaia – H2O Beach / Lake Siutghiol
spots.identity: Two nearby but materially different sectors: H2O sea beach for kite and Lake Siutghiol clubs for windsurf.
spots.conditions: H2O has a May–September thermal window, designated launch and services; the lake supports organised windsurf activity.
spots.access_rules: Split sea and lake sectors before publication and retain crowding, swimmer and shore-infrastructure constraints.
spots.trip_value: A mature activity scene and resort access support worth_trip once the mixed identity is corrected.

spots.name: Constanța – Zoom / WEGO sector
spots.identity: The documented WEGO/Zoom urban kite sector, replacing the unverified generic Modern Beach label.
spots.conditions: An official active-tourism portal lists the spot; secondary detail describes flat-to-small-wave water beside an urban pier.
spots.access_rules: Pin the current launch and document pier/rock, swimmers and any seasonal municipal restrictions.
spots.trip_value: Verified use is useful locally, but sources do not establish a distinctive travel proposition.

spots.name: Corbu beach
spots.identity: The natural Corbu beach within the Danube Delta Biosphere Reserve tourism perimeter.
spots.conditions: Low-authority local material reports windsurf/kitesurf use, but no supervised launch or robust conditions source is available.
spots.access_rules: Reserve permit, vehicle rules, approved tourist zone and absence of lifeguard must be resolved with the authority.
spots.trip_value: Wild-coast travel value is strong, but legal operation and sport evidence remain too uncertain.

spots.name: Vadu beach
spots.identity: The limited tourism-access part of Vadu's natural biosphere-reserve beach.
spots.conditions: No reliable discipline-specific use or condition evidence was found.
spots.access_rules: Reserve access, tourist-zone and vehicle restrictions apply; no launch should be inferred outside authorised areas.
spots.trip_value: Scenery and wind exposure do not establish a legal wind-sport destination.

spots.name: Gura Portiței
spots.identity: The boat-access settlement on the narrow Razim–Black Sea barrier.
spots.conditions: Official destination and resort sources establish unusual lagoon/sea geography but not recurring wind-sport use.
spots.access_rules: Confirm reserve rules, a legal launch, operator/rescue and transport of equipment.
spots.trip_value: Exceptional scenery is not enough without discipline-specific evidence.

spots.name: Sfântu Gheorghe, Danube Delta
spots.identity: The wild beach near the Sfântu Gheorghe arm mouth, outside the dangerous outlet itself.
spots.conditions: The broad shallow wild beach has high landscape value, but no reliable wind-sport scene or launch is documented.
spots.access_rules: Reserve rules, protected plants, no-lifeguard conditions and the river-mouth hazard require authority confirmation.
spots.trip_value: Remote trip value is clear, yet legal and discipline-specific evidence is insufficient.

spots.name: Eforie Nord
spots.identity: The resort beach at Eforie Nord, with no currently verified specialist launch.
spots.conditions: An older cross-border brochure mentions regional windsurf activity; current exact use and conditions are unverified.
spots.access_rules: Confirm a current operator, launch, wind window and swimmer separation.
spots.trip_value: Historic/general activity claims do not meet the evidence threshold.

spots.name: Limanu / Mangalia marina
spots.identity: The Limanu lake marina and sailing-school area, not an evidenced windsurf spot.
spots.conditions: Official records establish sailing instruction and marina use, but not windsurf/kite use or notable conditions.
spots.access_rules: Do not generalise sailing permission to boards or kites; confirm any public launch separately.
spots.trip_value: The candidate does not meet discipline-specific evidence requirements.

spots.name: Kilyos – Burç Beach
spots.identity: The Burç Beach wind/kite sector on Istanbul's Black Sea coast.
spots.conditions: Strong Black Sea wind and waves support multiple disciplines; the beach has hosted a kiteboard world championship and provides sport facilities.
spots.access_rules: Check current membership/guest access, operating season, rescue and swimmer separation before travel.
spots.trip_value: Competition history, official destination recognition and proximity to Istanbul support worth_trip.

spots.name: Gümüşdere Beach, Kilyos
spots.identity: The Gümüşdere/Goga school sector on the same wider Kilyos wind coast as Burç Beach.
spots.conditions: A current kite club offers lessons and equipment on a strong-wind, wave-exposed Black Sea beach.
spots.access_rules: Determine whether this should be a sector of one Kilyos record; confirm exact public access and rescue.
spots.trip_value: It has credible sport value but should not become a second destination-level count without a defensible boundary.

spots.name: Silivri – Semizkum
spots.identity: The Semizkum windsurf area west of Istanbul, not the whole Silivri shoreline.
spots.conditions: Secondary sources identify flat water, a club and Poyraz sessions, but modelled wind is relatively light and often offshore.
spots.access_rules: Confirm the active club/launch and retain offshore-wind, experience and rescue warnings.
spots.trip_value: Regional windsurf use is credible, but distinctive dedicated-trip value is not established.
